question: The musical instrument Sarod is associated with:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amjad Ali Khan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sarod:-**

 
 
• **It is a stringed musical instrument that originated in India.**
 
• It is similar to the Western lute, but with a shorter neck and a wider fingerboard.
 
• The instrument has a resonating chamber made of wood, and its strings are plucked with a plectrum made of coconut shell. 
 
• **Amjad Ali Khan is associated with Sarod.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Zakir Hussain:-**

 
 
• He is a renowned tabla player from India who has collaborated with many international musicians.
 
 
 
• **Allahrakha:-**
 
 
• He was a famous tabla player and percussionist who was known for his work with Ravi Shankar and other Indian classical musicians.
 
 
 
• **Khayyam:-**
 
 
• He was a Bollywood music composer who passed away in 2019.
 
• He was known for his work in films like Kabhie Kabhie and Umrao Jaan.
